name: Beginnings
source:
This game series titled 'Beginnings' drops you into the lead male protagonist's life at a pivotal point. He moved back in with his sister, Marcy, three months ago following a nasty breakup with his ex and has become a shut-in. At first Marcy was ok with this and let him cope in his own way but as time has passed she has become very worried for her brother and is determined to get him back out into the world. This is where the story picks up. After three months with virtually no interactions besides his sister, he finally gets pressured into going to a yoga class with Marcy, who wants to introduce him to the yoga instructor.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/easymuse]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
名為《開始》的系列遊戲將你帶入男主角人生的關鍵時刻。三個月前，他和前女友分手時鬧得很難看，於是搬回去跟姊姊瑪西同住，並把自己關在家裡。起初瑪西接受了他的狀態，任由他用自己的方式調適，但隨著時間推移，她越來越擔心弟弟，決心讓他重新走出家門。故事就從這裡開始。幾乎三個月沒有和姊姊以外的人交流後，他終於被瑪西說服參加瑜伽課，而她想把他介紹給瑜伽教練。

[來源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/easymuse]Patreon[/url]]
